title: PrivacyNoticePublished
description: CloudEvent data payload for dev.hugr.corelink.privacy_notice.published.v1. Emitted on every notice publication (major + minor). Per WI-S11-004 §6.1 + Lote 10.9bis P0-G prefix.

event_id.description: UUIDv7 event id for idempotency + audit trail localization.

version.description: New notice version (semver M.m convention; patch omitted).

bump.description: Bump type per ADR-S11-007. major = material change; minor = clarification.

material_change.description: Denormalized: true when bump = major (CTRL-PRIV-CONSENT-005 force re-consent trigger).

notice_text_hashes.description: SHA-256 hex64 notice_text_hash per locale. INV-CONSENT-PROOF-VERIFIABLE anchor for WI-S11-003 ConsentProofPayload.

emitted_at_ms.description: Wall-clock Unix epoch ms of emission.
